scope: Authorize the first 12 fresh Docs attempts; the remaining 36 are conditional on both predeclared Docs gates. No performance target is claimed achieved.

scoped_review.contact: Basic versus richer user-profile guidance corrected; bot, self and batch restrictions retained. No API implementation changed.
scoped_review.entry: Integrated dd0fc7a entry matches reviewed scratch 1adea39 byte-for-byte. Existing functions, references, rich-content fallbacks, native identity and mutation safeguards remain available.
scoped_review.docs_normalization: BOM, CRLF and blank separators within block bodies normalize locally. Native mutation algorithm is unchanged; marks, links, anchors, opaque regions and encoded native breaks retain fidelity checks. Blank lines before the first anchor remain rejected. Canonical plan equivalence and local/runtime regressions are adequate for this local-only acceptance change; no new native API contract is asserted.
scoped_review.diagnostics: Only bounded complete failed CLI JSON envelopes yield finite public diagnostic labels; no arbitrary output or identifiers retained. Adapter and harness sanitization do not affect accounting, verdicts or categories. Reviewer independently observed 24 adapter plus 27 harness tests pass on scratch 44e88fc; pure docworkspace package tests passed on 4e5e85d.
scoped_review.native_evidence: Prior private Docs evidence remains applicable to the unchanged API mutation algorithm. Source is newer for presentation normalization; this is not a claim of byte-identical private-QA and candidate binaries.

explicit_native_controls.scope: Frozen evaluator with explicit original and candidate binaries; paired native routes and native Codex sandbox controls.

provider_availability.limitation: Point-in-time connectivity evidence, not a guarantee that task usage will complete. Neither probe is an evaluation attempt or a CLI efficiency result.
provider_availability.configuration: Same native Codex executable, gpt-5.6-luna medium, isolated run_agent path and provider accounting; simple no-tool health prompt with a shorter 90-second probe budget.

conditional_design.docs_gate: For each Docs task: exactly three trials per arm, complete usage, no inconclusive outcomes, both success counts positive, Next successes >= original successes, and 2 * Next_tokens * original_successes < original_tokens * Next_successes. All attempt tokens count. Exactly 50 percent does not pass.
conditional_design.other_function_target: At least 30 percent fewer all-attempt tokens per verified success, with observed success nonregression.
conditional_design.stop_rule: If either Docs gate fails or is unavailable, retain all 12 attempts and report the remaining 36 as not run. No replacement, baseline reuse or condition pooling.
conditional_design.limitations: Conditional development sample, three repetitions, mutable provider alias. No independent confirmation, population parity or full functionality coverage claim.

checks_not_repeated: No tests or paid provider calls were rerun by this final review. Existing private API lifecycle and full condition05 harness evidence were not redundantly repeated; changed diagnostics had focused invariant/privacy tests and the current frozen paired/sandbox suites passed.
